title: Q-SAYDO-rules-CLONE-PATH-1: says CLONE-PATH-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CLONE-PATH-1
**Status:** closed

The system states `CLONE-PATH-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: org/owner-status.json

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:CLONE-PATH-1` exits 0.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T05:42:52Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
